in_marathi.name: Dhanaraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhan means wealth, Raj means king. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and represents a person who is wealthy and powerful, much like a king in Hindu mythology.
